# `aitbc node chain stop`

Stop a running parallel chain instance.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node chain stop [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node chain stop --chain-id <chain_id>
```
